name: context-keeper
description: Keeps long sessions sharp: compacts early, keeps a ledger of decisions, corrections and files that survives compaction.

threshold.title: Compact at context %
threshold.description: Compact once the context window is this full (20-90).

showRecent.title: List recent ledgers at start
showRecent.description: At session start, tell Claude about this project's 5 latest session ledgers (a few lines of context).

maxTokens.title: Compact at tokens
maxTokens.description: Compact once context reaches this many tokens, whichever comes first.
